mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_size_preference_profile ( user_id, category_key, explicit_preference, learned_direction, confidence_level, confidence_score, sample_count, fit_count, too_small_count, too_large_count, loose_signal_count, slim_signal_count, standard_signal_count, source_summary, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{categoryKey}, #{explicitPreference}, #{learnedDirection}, #{confidenceLevel}, #{confidenceScore}, #{sampleCount}, #{fitCount}, #{tooSmallCount}, #{tooLargeCount}, #{looseSignalCount}, #{slimSignalCount}, #{standardSignalCount}, #{sourceSummary}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE explicit_preference = VALUES(explicit_preference), learned_direction = VALUES(learned_direction), confidence_level = VALUES(confidence_level), confidence_score = VALUES(confidence_score), sample_count = VALUES(sample_count), fit_count = VALUES(fit_count), too_small_count = VALUES(too_small_count), too_large_count = VALUES(too_large_count), loose_signal_count = VALUES(loose_signal_count), slim_signal_count = VALUES(slim_signal_count), standard_signal_count = VALUES(standard_signal_count), source_summary = VALUES(source_summary), update_by = VALUES(update_by), update_time = VALUES(update_time)

INSERT INTO user_size_preference_event ( user_id, order_id, order_item_id, feedback_id, uniform_id, category_key, recommended_size, purchased_size, satisfaction, issue_parts, direction_delta, source_type, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{orderId}, #{orderItemId}, #{feedbackId}, #{uniformId}, #{categoryKey}, #{recommendedSize}, #{purchasedSize}, #{satisfaction}, #{issueParts}, #{directionDelta}, #{sourceType}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id = VALUES(user_id), order_id = VALUES(order_id), feedback_id = VALUES(feedback_id), uniform_id = VALUES(uniform_id), category_key = VALUES(category_key), recommended_size = VALUES(recommended_size), purchased_size = VALUES(purchased_size), satisfaction = VALUES(satisfaction), issue_parts = VALUES(issue_parts), direction_delta = VALUES(direction_delta), source_type = VALUES(source_type), update_by = VALUES(update_by), update_time = VALUES(update_time)
mapper.select: SELECT sf.user_id, sf.order_id, sf.order_item_id, sf.feedback_id, COALESCE(rl.uniform_id, soi.uniform_id) AS uniform_id, COALESCE(rl.category_key, su.category_key, 'GENERAL') AS category_key, COALESCE(rl.recommended_size_name, sf.recommended_size) AS recommended_size, COALESCE(sf.purchased_size, soi.size_name_snapshot) AS purchased_size, sf.satisfaction, sf.issue_parts, COALESCE(sf.update_time, sf.create_time) AS feedback_time FROM size_feedback sf INNER JOIN s_orders so ON so.id = sf.order_id INNER JOIN s_order_items soi ON soi.order_item_id = sf.order_item_id LEFT JOIN recommendation_log rl ON rl.order_item_id = sf.order_item_id LEFT JOIN s_uniform su ON su.id = COALESCE(rl.uniform_id, soi.uniform_id) WHERE so.status = 3 AND COALESCE(so.payment_status, '') NOT IN ('REFUNDING', 'REFUNDED', 'CLOSED') AND COALESCE(so.shipping_status, '') NOT IN ('RETURN_REQUESTED', 'RETURNED')
